commands.migrated.close.description: The name Hive gives the command the user had in Settings → Workspace → When this workspace closes, run, as it becomes one of the workspace's named commands (HI-1954). The user can rename it.

commands.migrated.quit.description: The name Hive gives the command the user had in Settings → General → When Hive quits, run, as it becomes one of Hive's named commands (HI-1954). The user can rename it.

commands.run.gone.defaultMessage: That command is no longer there.
commands.run.gone.description: An error: the user ran one of their commands by hand (Settings → Commands, or the command palette), but it was deleted meanwhile.

commands.run.testCopy.defaultMessage: This is a test copy of Combwork: it doesn't run your commands.
commands.run.testCopy.description: An error in a test copy of Hive (one the developers' tests start): it never runs the user's own commands.
